---
title: "Menzerath's law from random peaks"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(lmerTest)
set.seed(2137)
```

## Simulated data

With `b = 0`, nothing links submovement duration to the number of submovements
With `b < 0`, gestures with more submovements are sped up, i.e., a real Menzerath effect

```{r}
make_data <- function(b = 0, gap = 0.1) {
  n_spk  <- c(ECOLANG = 15, MULTISIMO = 18, GESres = 7, SAGA = 4, SAGAplus = 10, ZHUBO = 1)
  n_gest <- c(ECOLANG = 3718, MULTISIMO = 1188, GESres = 1029, SAGA = 687, SAGAplus = 675, ZHUBO = 86)
  g <- rbindlist(lapply(names(n_spk), function(cc) {
    rate <- rlnorm(n_spk[cc], log(2.5), 0.15)              # peaks per second, per speaker
    s <- sample(n_spk[cc], n_gest[cc], replace = TRUE)
    data.table(corpus = cc, speaker = paste0(cc, "_", s), rate = rate[s])
  }))
  g[, `:=`(gid = seq_len(.N), dur = rlnorm(.N, log(1.4), 0.5))]
  g[, {
    t <- cumsum(gap + rexp(ceiling(dur / gap) + 2, 1 / (1 / rate - gap)))
    t <- t - runif(1) * t[1]
    iv <- diff(t[t <= dur])
    if (length(iv) >= 2) {
      f <- (length(iv) / 4)^b
      list(sub_dur = iv * f, gesture_dur = dur * f, n_sub = length(iv))
    }
  }, by = .(corpus, speaker, gid)]
}

paper_model <- function(d) {
  d <- copy(d)
  d[, x := scale(log(n_sub))[, 1]]
  d[, y := scale(log(sub_dur))[, 1]]
  lmer(y ~ x + (1 | corpus/speaker/gid), data = d)
}

d0 <- make_data(b = 0)
d1 <- make_data(b = -0.1)
```

## Paper's model, data without a Menzerath effect

```{r}
m0 <- paper_model(d0)
summary(m0)$coefficients
VarCorr(m0)
```

## Null model

```{r}
sim_gesture <- function(dur, mean_iv, gap = 0.1) {
  for (i in 1:1000) {
    t <- cumsum(gap + rexp(ceiling(dur / gap) + 2, 1 / (mean_iv - gap)))
    t <- t - runif(1) * t[1]
    iv <- diff(t[t <= dur])
    if (length(iv) >= 2) return(iv)
  }
  NULL
}

null_slopes <- function(d, nsim = 100) {
  gest <- unique(d[, .(corpus, speaker, gid, gesture_dur, n_sub)])
  gest[, mean_iv := sum(gesture_dur) / sum(n_sub + 1), by = speaker]
  for (r in 1:3) {
    s <- gest[, .(n = length(sim_gesture(gesture_dur, mean_iv))), by = gid]
    gest[s, on = "gid", n_sim := i.n]
    gest[, mean_iv := 0.1 + (mean_iv - 0.1) * mean(n_sim) / mean(n_sub), by = speaker]
  }
  sapply(1:nsim, function(k) {
    s <- gest[, .(sub_dur = sim_gesture(gesture_dur, mean_iv)), by = .(corpus, speaker, gid)]
    s[, n_sub := .N, by = gid]
    unname(fixef(paper_model(s))["x"])
  })
}
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# warnings come from the zero gesture and corpus variances (see VarCorr above)
null0 <- null_slopes(d0)
m1 <- paper_model(d1)
null1 <- null_slopes(d1)
```

## Results

```{r}
res <- rbind(
  no_effect   = c(observed = fixef(m0)[["x"]], null_mean = mean(null0),
                  quantile(null0, c(0.025, 0.975)), p = (1 + sum(null0 <= fixef(m0)[["x"]])) / 101),
  real_effect = c(observed = fixef(m1)[["x"]], null_mean = mean(null1),
                  quantile(null1, c(0.025, 0.975)), p = (1 + sum(null1 <= fixef(m1)[["x"]])) / 101))
round(res, 3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(null0, main = "b = 0", xlab = "slope", xlim = range(null0, fixef(m0)["x"]))
abline(v = fixef(m0)["x"], col = "red")
hist(null1, main = "b = -0.1", xlab = "slope", xlim = range(null1, fixef(m1)["x"]))
abline(v = fixef(m1)["x"], col = "red")
```

## Per-corpus models (as in Wim's script), data without an effect

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
per_corpus <- function(d) {
  rbindlist(lapply(split(d, by = "corpus"), function(x) {
    x <- copy(x)
    x[, xs := scale(log(n_sub))[, 1]]
    x[, ys := scale(log(sub_dur))[, 1]]
    f <- if (uniqueN(x$speaker) > 1) ys ~ xs + (1 | speaker/gid) else ys ~ xs + (1 | gid)
    m <- lmer(f, data = x, REML = FALSE)
    data.table(corpus = x$corpus[1], gestures = uniqueN(x$gid), beta = fixef(m)[["xs"]],
               p = coef(summary(m))["xs", "Pr(>|t|)"], singular = isSingular(m))
  }))
}

pc <- per_corpus(d0)
pc[, `:=`(p_bonferroni = p.adjust(p, "bonferroni"), p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))]
pc
```
